base_url.description: Base URL of the InsightVM Security Console, including the port (e.g. https://insightvm.example.com:3780)

username.description: Username of the Security Console account used to query the API (the account must not use two-factor authentication)

password.description: Password of the Security Console account

verify_certificate.description: Verify the TLS certificate of the Security Console. Disable it only for a console using a self-signed certificate
